title: Tiger cub reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tiger cub body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#f4a125'/>
  <!-- haunches/belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- stripes on body -->
  <path d='M28 62 q4 6 1 12' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 62 q-4 6 -1 12' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 84 q4 -6 8 0' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 84 q-4 -6 -8 0' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='20' fill='#f4a125'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='24' r='6' fill='#f4a125'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='6' fill='#f4a125'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d='M50 21 q-2 5 0 8' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 23 q2 4 0 7' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 23 q-2 4 0 7' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 36 q4 2 4 4' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 36 q-4 2 -4 4' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- eyes (gentle, looking down) -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='38' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='38' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#fff1c4'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#fff1c4'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 44 h6 l-3 3 z' fill='#c0573a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 47 v2 M50 49 q-3 3 -5 0' stroke='#c0573a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 49 q3 3 5 0' stroke='#c0573a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M38 46 l-8 -2 M38 49 l-8 2' stroke='#fff1c4' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 46 l8 -2 M62 49 l8 2' stroke='#fff1c4' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='66' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f4a125'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='66' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f4a125'/>
  <!-- open book -->
  <path d='M30 62 q10 -6 20 -2 l0 16 q-10 -4 -20 2 z' fill='#f0f0ff'/>
  <path d='M70 62 q-10 -6 -20 -2 l0 16 q10 -4 20 2 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M50 60 v16' stroke='#b8b8d8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- text lines on book -->
  <path d='M34 63 h11 M34 67 h11 M34 71 h9' stroke='#7a8adf' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 63 h11 M55 67 h11 M57 71 h9' stroke='#7a8adf' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book cover edges -->
  <path d='M30 62 q10 -6 20 -2' stroke='#c0573a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 62 q-10 -6 -20 -2' stroke='#c0573a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
